import heapq

def simulate_game(deck):
    # Piles sums
    S1 = 0
    S2 = 0
    # Min-heap (negative values simulate max-heap)
    available_cards = [-c for c in deck]
    heapq.heapify(available_cards)

    # Turn counter: 1, 2, 3, ...
    turn = 0

    while available_cards:
        turn += 1
        # 1. Choose the largest card (Greedy strategy)
        card = -heapq.heappop(available_cards)

        # 2. Determine player and goal
        # Turn 1, 3, 5, ... (Odd turns) -> Grogg (Minimizer)
        if turn % 2 != 0:
            # Grogg minimizes |S1 - S2|
            diff1_if_p1 = abs((S1 + card) - S2)
            diff2_if_p2 = abs(S1 - (S2 + card))

            if diff1_if_p1 <= diff2_if_p2:
                S1 += card
            else:
                S2 += card
        # Turn 2, 4, 6, ... (Even turns) -> Winnie (Maximizer)
        else:
            # Winnie maximizes |S1 - S2|
            diff1_if_p1 = abs((S1 + card) - S2)
            diff2_if_p2 = abs(S1 - (S2 + card))

            if diff1_if_p1 >= diff2_if_p2:
                S1 += card
            else:
                S2 += card

    return S1, S2

# Deck 1 through 50
deck = list(range(1, 51))
S1_final, S2_final = simulate_game(deck)

difference = abs(S1_final - S2_final)
print(f"S1: {S1_final}")
print(f"S2: {S2_final}")
print(f"Difference: {difference}")
